Constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].

edges.reason: transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed nested mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance in allowed.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
msg.sender is used as the balance mapping key in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner key in approve and transferFrom.
Owner is assigned directly from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to equal owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal newOwner.
onlyOwner gates the arbitrary external token transfer in transferAnyERC20Token.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an untrusted spender contract, handing control to arbitrary code.
The callee reached through receiveApproval can re-enter approveAndCall or transferFrom before the caller returns.
transferAnyERC20Token executes an external call on an owner-supplied arbitrary token address.
The external token transfer sends funds to the owner state variable.
totalSupply performs the raw subtraction without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtraction reads _totalSupply and can underflow.
Unchecked subtraction reads balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend.
transfer delegates its debit arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates its credit arithmetic to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the destination credit.
Constructor writes the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to a hardcoded address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply storage variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
acceptOwnership clears the newOwner slot after transfer.
transfer destination parameter feeds the balances credit key.
transfer amount parameter feeds the safeSub and safeAdd computations.
approve spender parameter is written into the allowed mapping.
approve amount parameter is written into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom from parameter keys both balances and allowed.
transferFrom to parameter keys the destination balance credit.
transferFrom amount parameter is subtracted and added.
approveAndCall spender parameter keys the allowance and the external callback target.
approveAndCall amount parameter is written to allowance and forwarded to the callee.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the untrusted callee.
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied address in newOwner.
transferAnyERC20Token tokenAddress parameter becomes the external call target.
transferAnyERC20Token amount parameter becomes the external call argument.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter keys the balances mapping read.
allowance tokenOwner parameter keys the outer allowed mapping.
allowance spender parameter keys the inner allowed mapping.
safeAdd return local receives the computed sum.
safeSub return local receives the computed difference.
safeMul return local receives the computed product.
safeDiv return local receives the computed quotient.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied destination address only exists to key the balances mapping inside transfer.
Amount argument is consumed immediately by the safeSub/safeAdd calls in transfer.
Spender argument is only used to index the allowed mapping in approve.
Allowance amount is written straight into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Source address is only used to key balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
Destination address is only used for the balance credit in transferFrom.
Amount argument drives the safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is both the allowance key and the untrusted callback target of the external call.
Token amount is stored in allowance and passed to the external callback.
Opaque calldata is forwarded unchanged into the untrusted callee.
New owner argument is assigned to the newOwner state variable of the function.
User-supplied address becomes the target contract of the external call.
Amount argument is forwarded directly to the external token contract.
Queried address is only a lookup key for the balances mapping.
Owner argument is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping.
Spender argument is only a lookup key for the allowed mapping.
Return variable exists solely to carry safeAdd's result.
Return variable exists solely to carry safeSub's result.
Return variable exists solely to carry safeMul's result.
Return variable exists solely to carry safeDiv's result.
